sloka: हतामिन्द्रजिता सीतामिह श्रुत्वैव राघवः।हनुमद्वचनात् सौम्य ततो मोहमुपागतः ।। ६.८४.७ ।।
transliteration: hatāmindrajitā sītāmiha śrutvaiva rāghavaḥ।hanumadvacanāt saumya tato mohamupāgataḥ ।। 6.84.7 ।।

translations.english: "O Noble one! On hearing Hanuman that Sita is killed by Indrajith, Rama is deluded', said Lakshmana to Vibheeshana."
